data.content:
Blue Beetle II (Theodore Kord) is published by **DC Comics**, and "Brightest Day" is a DC Comics crossover storyline.

## Answer

**"Brightest Day"** is a 2010–2011 crossover storyline published by **DC Comics** — the same publisher as Blue Beetle II (Theodore Kord). Its significance:

- It was a year-long comic book maxi-series that began in April 2010, accompanied by numerous tie-in books (source: ctx://team/engineering/hydra/kilt/25769371/0000).
- It directly follows the ending of the "Blackest Night" storyline and explores how its aftermath affects the entire DC Universe (same source).
- At the end of "Blackest Night" (2009–2010), 12 deceased heroes and villains were resurrected for an unknown purpose; "Brightest Day" follows these characters as they seek to learn the secret behind their return to life (source: ctx://team/engineering/hydra/kilt/25769371/0001).

In short, "Brightest Day" served as the sequel/aftermath to "Blackest Night," a major DC Comics event that resurrected a dozen characters and reshaped the DC Universe — the shared fictional universe in which Blue Beetle II exists.

Blue Beetle II (Theodore Kord) is published by **DC Comics**, and "Brightest Day" is a DC Comics crossover storyline.

## Answer

**"Brightest Day"** is a 2010–2011 crossover storyline published by **DC Comics** — the same publisher as Blue Beetle II (Theodore Kord). Its significance:

- It was a year-long comic book maxi-series that began in April 2010, accompanied by numerous tie-in books (source: ctx://team/engineering/hydra/kilt/25769371/0000).
- It directly follows the ending of the "Blackest Night" storyline and explores how its aftermath affects the entire DC Universe (same source).
- At the end of "Blackest Night" (2009–2010), 12 deceased heroes and villains were resurrected for an unknown purpose; "Brightest Day" follows these characters as they seek to learn the secret behind their return to life (source: ctx://team/engineering/hydra/kilt/25769371/0001).

In short, "Brightest Day" served as the sequel/aftermath to "Blackest Night," a major DC Comics event that resurrected a dozen characters and reshaped the DC Universe — the shared fictional universe in which Blue Beetle II exists.
